checks.name: Zero Plaintext Credentials
checks.description: All API tokens and secrets loaded via environment variables.

checks.name: Path Traversal Sandboxing
checks.description: path.resolve() sandbox boundary validation prevents directory escapes.

checks.name: Runtime Zod Schema Validation
checks.description: Every tool call argument validated against strict Zod schema.

checks.name: Zero Arbitrary Shell Execution
checks.description: Child process exec() prohibited; only deterministic utilities permitted.

checks.name: JSON-RPC 2.0 Schema Conformance
checks.description: All responses comply with JSON-RPC 2.0 specifications.

checks.name: Bearer Token Auth for SSE
checks.description: HTTP SSE endpoints protected by Bearer token authorization.

checks.name: Payload Size Capping
checks.description: Maximum JSON-RPC payload size capped at 4MB to prevent memory exhaustion.

checks.name: CORS Origin Restriction
checks.description: SSE endpoints restrict cross-origin access to allowlisted origins.

checks.name: Rate Limiting on Tool Invocations
checks.description: Per-client rate limiting prevents tool abuse and denial-of-service.

checks.name: Safe Math & Query Evaluation
checks.description: No eval() or new Function() used in calculation or query tools.

checks.name: Structured Error Code Sanitization
checks.description: Internal stack traces masked in client error responses.

checks.name: SAST Semgrep OSS Scan
checks.description: 0 blocking findings on OWASP Top 10 ruleset.
